metric_definitions.conditional_chunk_recall: mean query-level recall over gold refs whose parent post is in the frozen Top10 post set
metric_definitions.final_evidence_recall: mean query-level recall over all frozen answerable gold refs
metric_definitions.chunk_mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the first ranked chunk covering any query gold source chunk
metric_definitions.gold_preservation: old gold source chunk ID has a deterministic merged item mapping
metric_definitions.duplicate_slot_waste: selected Top10 slots equivalent to an earlier selected content item
metric_definitions.source_loss: source chunk IDs absent from the assembled partition
metric_definitions.source_duplication: extra occurrences of source chunk IDs in the assembled partition
